content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Dry bulk ship charterer for miners and steel makers; different vessel type, cargo and customers from LPG gas carriers."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Truckload, intermodal and brokerage freight for North American shippers; no seaborne gas transport."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Expedition cruises and land tours sold to leisure travelers; a consumer travel business, not gas shipping."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Construction and maintenance contractor for telecom, utility and pipeline builds; no vessel operation or shipping."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Rents and fabricates onshore natural gas compressors for producers; no seaborne cargo transport."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"US less-than-truckload trucking network for business shippers; road freight rather than ocean gas carriage."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Dry bulk ship operator carrying grains, coal and ore; different cargo, vessel type and customers than LPG."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Oil refiner selling fuels and running retail stations; manufacturing and retail, not seaborne LPG transport."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Online and live auctions of used industrial equipment and trucks; a marketplace, not shipping services."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"On-site inspection, repair and heat treating for plant owners; field maintenance services, not vessel operation."}]}
